item.title: What Can We Do About Reward Hacking?: Concrete Problems in AI Safety Part 4
item.chain_str:
RISK: Catastrophic reward hacking in autonomous AI systems
  PROBLEM ANALYSIS: Adversarial examples enabling unintended high reward in neural networks
  THEORETICAL INSIGHT: Adversarial training improves robustness to adversarial examples in neural networks
  DESIGN RATIONALE: Integrate adversarial training into RL reward learning pipeline
  IMPLEMENTATION MECHANISM: On-the-fly generation of adversarial inputs during training for robustness
  VALIDATION EVIDENCE: Empirical adversarial example defenses in neural networks show increased robustness
  INTERVENTION (model-assigned maturity 3): Apply adversarial training during fine-tuning to reduce reward hacking via adversarial examples
